# uptimekuma_notification_nostr (Resource)

Nostr notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_nostr" "example" {
  name = "Nostr Notification"

  # Sender's private key in Nostr format (nsec encoded)
  # This is a sensitive value and should be protected
  sender = "nsec1vl5dr5z69cydfy5kqsruqh84zkyv684jpu7v0unv2dl0aq2t5spe5nqq"

  # Newline-delimited list of recipient public keys (npub encoded)
  # These are public keys and can be shared openly
  recipients = "npub1qypt4l5elx7qjxapqvzc3gw7nj5zxwq5r5rzc5yqgj5j5j5j5j5j5j5j5j5j"

  # Newline-delimited list of Nostr relay URLs
  relays = "wss://relay.example.com\nwss://relay2.example.com"

  # Optional: Enable or disable the notification

  # Optional: Mark as default notification
  is_default = false

  # Optional: Apply to existing monitors
  apply_existing = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: sender_wo is never stored in plan
# or state. Change the matching *_wo_version whenever a secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_nostr" "write_only" {
  name       = "Nostr with write-only secret"
  recipients = "npub1qypt4l5elx7qjxapqvzc3gw7nj5zxwq5r5rzc5yqgj5j5j5j5j5j5j5j5j5j"
  relays     = "wss://relay.example.com"

  sender_wo         = "nsec1vl5dr5z69cydfy5kqsruqh84zkyv684jpu7v0unv2dl0aq2t5spe5nqq"
  sender_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `recipients` (String) Newline-delimited list of recipient public keys (npub encoded)
- `relays` (String) Newline-delimited list of Nostr relay URLs

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `sender` (String, Sensitive) Sender private key in Nostr format (nsec encoded). Stored in state; use `sender_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `sender_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Sender private key in Nostr format (nsec encoded), write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `sender`; requires `sender_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `sender_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `sender` until the next apply with `sender_wo` set removes it from state.
- `sender_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `sender_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `sender_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
